subject: Request: Long-term audit retention for inference logs - Firstrust
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@firstrustbank.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Audits <audits@firstrustbank.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T16:12:00Z
Subject: Request: long-term retention of inference & debug logs for audit

Hi Monica,

Thanks for the demo last week — Firstrust has a follow-up ask from our compliance and audits team. Our regulators require a 7-year retention for certain categories of inference output and request traces tied to regulated decisioning. We understand Redwood's default retention for debug/inference logs is 30 days, but we need to discuss options for a scoped exception for: 

- inference request/response pairs for accounts that touch regulated products (marked by customer ID)
- associated debug traces and metadata sufficient to reproduce decisions

Attached is a short spec and a draft MAA spreadsheet our procurement team sent over (Firstrust_log_spec_request.pdf / MAA_firstrust_v0.1.xlsx). Key asks:

1) Can Redwood provide a signed technical addendum agreeing to retain the defined artifacts for 7 years?
2) Can retention be scoped to specific Firstrust tenant IDs and encrypted with a customer-managed KMS?
3) What safeguards are available for access, searchability, and export for audits (redaction, pseudonymization, chain-of-custody)?

We'd like to understand technical feasibility, timeline, and any commercial implications (pricing, SLA). Could you loop in security/engineering? We aim to have a mutual action plan by Oct 10.

Thanks,
Oliver Grant
Lead, Regulatory Compliance
Firstrust Bank

--- Attachment stubs: Firstrust_log_spec_request.pdf, MAA_firstrust_v0.1.xlsx

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@firstrustbank.com>
Cc: Audits <audits@firstrustbank.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-02T13:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: long-term retention of inference & debug logs for audit

Hi Oliver — thanks for the clear spec and the MAA. Looping in Karthik (serving/runtime) and Neha (security/compliance) to confirm constraints and propose options.

Preliminary answers and open items:
- Scope: retaining artifacts scoped by Firstrust tenant IDs is feasible; we can tag at ingestion and apply targeted retention.
- Encryption: we support CM-KMS for Private deployments and for Dedicated customers; for hosted accounts we can offer envelope encryption and a contract requirement for key residency controls — need security to confirm the exact guarantees.
- Access & Auditability: we can provide an "audit bundle" export (timebox, signed manifest) and role-based access + SIEM hooks.

Open questions for your procurement team (will help Karthik size changes):
1) Do you require raw request/response payloads stored in cleartext, or would pseudonymized payloads (PII redaction) satisfy the regulator?
2) Is retention required for all inference on regulated products, or a sampled/replayable subset?
3) Any constraints on where keys must live (US-only, customer HSM, etc.)?

I'll work with the team and send a recommended path and an initial redline for a technical addendum by Oct 6. If acceptable, we can build an MAA with milestones (engineering design -> compliance review -> contract addendum -> DocuSign).

Best,
Monica Patel
Director, Customer Security & Trust
Redwood Inference

--- Attachment: MAA_firstrust_v0.1.xlsx (received)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-03T09:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: long-term retention of inference & debug logs for audit

Monica — quick tech readout. TL;DR: doable with trade-offs. Proposed mitigations and implementation sketch: 

1) Architecture options (ranked by effort/cost):
  - Private deployment (customer VPC/on-prem): full CMK control, straightforward 7-yr retention under customer's policies (highest isolation, higher cost).
  - Dedicated reserved capacity with customer KMS binding + segmented storage bucket: retain targeted tenant IDs for 7 yrs with encryption-at-rest and access logging.
  - Hosted hybrid (our default): we can provide encryption envelope + MFA-protected audit export, but CM-KMS for hosted is operationally limited — propose an escrow-for-audit model (signed snapshots to a secure escrow with verifiable manifests).

2) Data model & minimization: store a compact audit bundle per inference that contains: request header (non-PII), model response hash, deterministic trace of decision steps, and optionally pseudonymized payloads. This reduces exposure and storage while meeting reproduceability.

3) Access controls & chain-of-custody: implement time-limited audit tokens for downloads, SIEM integration for every export, and HMAC-signed manifests to prove integrity.

4) Compliance artifacts: we can provide a sample SOC2 control narrative update and a CAIQ/SIG supplement describing the retention carveout. Neha should confirm whether a CAIQ annotation is needed.

Estimated effort: 3 weeks for engineering design + 6-8 weeks for implementation (for dedicated/persistent retention path). Pricing: we'll need to price per-GB/year for retained audit bundles; I'll ask pricing to provide a ballpark.

If we proceed, suggested immediate next steps:
- Confirm whether Firstrust accepts pseudonymization for payloads (this materially reduces risk + cost).
- Decide on deployment model (Private vs Dedicated vs Hosted escrow).
- Agree on MAA milestones & sign-off authority.

Karthik
VP, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@firstrustbank.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, Audits <audits@firstrustbank.com>
Date: 2026-10-06T11:48:00Z
Subject: Proposed mutual action plan & technical addendum (draft)

Hi Oliver — following internal review, attached is a proposed mutual action plan (MAA_firstrust_v0.1.xlsx) and an initial redline of the technical addendum (redline_firstrust_addendum.docx). Summary of the proposed approach: 

1) Scope: scoped retention limited to Firstrust-regulated tenant IDs (identified in the MAA).
2) Data minimization: retention will be of a compact "audit bundle" (metadata + deterministic trace + pseudonymized payload unless cleartext is explicitly required by regulator).
3) Encryption & keys: preferred path is Dedicated or Private with customer-managed KMS; if Firstrust must remain on hosted, we will provide escrowed, HMAC-signed snapshots with audited access.
4) Controls: time-bound audit tokens, SIEM exports, signed integrity manifests.
5) Timeline & milestones:
  - Oct 6: Agree MAA & deployment model
  - Oct 13: Engineering scoping complete & pricing estimate
  - Nov 10: Implementation for Dedicated/Private (if chosen) OR escrow process live for hosted

Open items we need from you to finalize scoping: 
- Confirmation on pseudonymization vs raw payloads
- List of tenant IDs to be covered
- Any KMS residency/HSM constraints

If you confirm scope and sign the MAA, we'll prepare a DocuSign for the technical addendum. We can also draft a CAIQ annotation for your auditor that explains the carveout and controls.

Thanks — happy to run a 30-minute working session this week to finalize.

Best,
Monica Patel
Director, Customer Security & Trust
Redwood Inference

--- Attachments: MAA_firstrust_v0.1.xlsx, redline_firstrust_addendum.docx

From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@firstrustbank.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Audits <audits@firstrustbank.com>, security@firstrustbank.com
Date: 2026-10-08T15:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Proposed mutual action plan & technical addendum (draft)

Monica — thanks, this looks reasonable and pragmatic. Firstrust is amenable to pseudonymization as a first pass; procurement will confirm tenant list by EOD Monday. We prefer Dedicated reserved capacity with CM-KMS if pricing is within expected ballpark.

Please prepare:
- a short one-page control statement (for procurement/proof to regulator) that we can include in our vendor folder,
- a DocuSign-ready addendum once we confirm tenant IDs.

We'd like an interim escrow option in case the Dedicated timeline slips. Otherwise, agree to the MAA milestones.

Oliver Grant
Lead, Regulatory Compliance
Firstrust Bank

--- Note: Customer confirms they will send tenant list (CSV) and expects DocuSign by Oct 12.
